From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Possibly borrowed from Polish akuratny or German akkurat,[1] from Latin accūrātus +‎ -ный (-nyj).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɐkʊˈratnɨj]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Saint Petersburg):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

аккура́тный • (akkurátnyj) (comparative (по)аккура́тнее or (по)аккура́тней, adverb аккура́тно, abstract noun аккура́тность, diminutive аккура́тненький)

  1. accurate, punctual, exact, thorough
  2. tidy, neat
  3. careful, cautious
